defect.proposed_fix: Keep Treatment: good as of 2026-06-30, but qualify the subsequent-history sentence to say no accepted negative treatment is shown in the disclosed lake record; proposed progeny edges remain audit risks.

reasons: The lake treatment judgment itself says field_i_validity is good_law, as_of_treatment is 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.
All disclosed progeny edges are marked proposed and have field_iii as mentioned, so they do not by themselves establish that Banks has been overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited.
The derivation metadata nevertheless flags audit_needed/cap_hit/proposed_negative_events, so an absolute no-negative-treatment statement should be softened.
residual_risks: A completed treatment audit or fresh CourtListener check would be needed to make an unqualified no-negative-treatment assertion as of 2026-06-30.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use: 'No accepted negative treatment shown in the disclosed lake record; treatment audit flags proposed edges for review.'
